tasks.task: Write a YouTube video script that holds viewers

items.when: When the title and promise are set and you need a timed script with B-roll notes and chapters
Before the full draft, to get several scored opening options and a second take on the script
When the first line is flat, to get ten different openings and the two to film first
When the script tells everything at once and needs a reason to keep watching
When the draft is done, to find and fix every line that trips when spoken
Before filming, to give every fact in the script a dated source, a rewrite or a cut

tasks.task: Write the title and thumbnail pair for a video

items.when: When you know the video's promise and need a title and thumbnail that say it together
When you want several different pairs to compare, with the first minute written to pay them off
When the pair is accurate but nobody would click it, or it promises more than the video gives
Before upload, to check title length and that the thumbnail does not repeat the title
When you have two to four pairs and want a fresh reviewer to pick one and say what to borrow

tasks.task: Design three thumbnail concepts for a video

items.when: Before any layout, to find the one idea, one feeling and one image the thumbnail should carry
When the client must see three clearly different thumbnails at real size, with one chosen
When each concept needs its face, object, three words at most and a matching title
When the thumbnail is a collage of everything and needs one bold shape
When a thumbnail is drafted, to score what a viewer takes in within three seconds
When the client's team will build the chosen thumbnail themselves from a template

tasks.task: Build a six-month channel plan and topic map

items.when: Before the plan, to find the three to five subjects the business can speak on again and again
When you know the business goal and need series, topics, cadence and targets for six months
When the client could go search-led or series-led, to compare two plans with hours and dates
When the owner has few free hours and the plan must fit them, with what to drop first
When the plan guesses who watches, to ask where these buyers really pay attention
When the plan is drafted, to have a fresh reviewer read it as the client and list fixes

tasks.task: Find video topics people search for

items.when: When you have customer questions, comments or Trends screenshots and need ideas people look for
When you need a ranked list of question searches grouped by what the searcher wants
When the best source is what viewers ask and complain about in their own words
When you want videos in the niche that beat their channel's usual views, as topic proof

tasks.task: Set up title and thumbnail test variants

items.when: When a video is nearly ready and you need the pair to publish plus variants for Test and compare
When the variants are too alike and you need pairs that test truly different promises
When you want one guided run from picking the pair to the change that holds viewers
When you must pick the pair to publish first and want a pick that is not your own

tasks.task: Review 90 days of channel analytics

items.when: When you have YouTube Studio exports or screenshots and need a read by series, source and audience
Every 90 days, or when growth stalls, to run the review and the refresh in a set order
When you have only a channel link or three videos and need the one fix that matters most

tasks.task: Fix where viewers leave a published video

items.when: When you have only the link and need a clean transcript to set against the graph
When you have the retention export, to see where viewers leave and what was said then
When you know the dips and need the weak passages rewritten for the next video or a re-cut
When there is no clear dip, to map the script's flat spots and get one fix
When the opening takes too long to reach the point and needs cutting to what viewers need

tasks.task: Cut a long video into Shorts and script new ones

items.when: When you have a long video, webinar or podcast and want Shorts that send viewers to the full one
When you have the transcript and need the best five moments, each with a new first line
When you want one run that gives the cut list, the chapters and five clips together
When the Short is new, not a clip, to pick a format and get an outline and ten openings
When a clip's first line is weak, to get ten openings checked for length and first shot
Before cutting, to score each opening out of 100 and get rewrites for the weak ones
When the owner will cut, caption and resize the Shorts on a phone

tasks.task: Write the description, chapters, tags and captions

items.when: When the video is cut and needs a description and tags built around the searches to win
When you have the transcript and need chapters that follow YouTube's rules and show up
When the video has no captions and needs a transcript and a timed subtitle file
When you want a second version of the title, description and timestamps to compare
When the description links to an offer, to check a viewer can get it today from that link

tasks.task: Refresh titles and descriptions on older videos

items.when: When you need the list of uploads and a search inside them before you choose which to refresh
When older videos still get views but little search traffic, or titles miss what people search
When one old video is stuck, to audit its title, description and tags and get new ones
Before you change a live title, to check length and that it does not repeat the thumbnail

tasks.task: Run the weekly video cycle from idea to upload

items.when: Every week on a fixed day, for each long video in the plan and the Shorts that follow it
When the week is short on hours and you must choose formats and what to drop first

tasks.task: Build a thumbnail style system for a channel

items.when: When the client shares thumbnails they like, to turn them into colours, type and feel to reuse
When the channel has no look yet, to compare three directions made at real size
When a direction is picked, to write firm rules for colour, type and layout on every thumbnail
When the look uses the host's portrait and a title, to set one recipe anyone can repeat
When the system is drafted, to test sample thumbnails for a three-second read at small size

tasks.task: Write AI image prompts for thumbnail backgrounds

items.when: When you need a prompt that sets subject, light, camera and style, with a leave-out list
When one background idea should be tried as four different treatments
When the image itself must carry two or three words spelt correctly
When a background is made, to check the face and words still read over it in three seconds

tasks.task: Plan a face-shot set-up for thumbnails

items.when: When the host or a photographer needs one brief for the expressions, light and backdrop
Before the shoot, to fix how the portrait sits with the title so the shots fit the layout

tasks.task: Script a tutorial or explainer video

items.when: Before writing, to plan which diagram or visual pairs with the words so the point sticks
When the steps are known and you need timed sections that each pay off for the viewer
When you want a different structure for the same lesson, with what shows on screen
When a hard idea must be made clear without losing what the evidence really shows
When the steps read well on paper, to catch lines that trip when said aloud

tasks.task: Plan a video series or a founder-led run

items.when: When the founder is on camera and you have buyer questions for a ten-week plan and set-up
When one subject should run across parts, to give each part a job and a reason to return
When the client wants a month of episodes, the first script and an edit plan in one run
When you have two or three series ideas and want a fresh reviewer to pick one

tasks.task: Study rival channels and winning videos

items.when: When you need the niche's videos that beat their channel's usual views, ranked
When you need a rival channel's video list, new uploads and transcripts to read
When you have rival videos and want their openings, claims and themes pulled out
When one channel is the model, to write up its positioning, themes and what to test

tasks.task: Start a brand's channel from zero

items.when: When there is no channel yet and the client wants ideas, scripts, thumbnails and a calendar
When the first six months need series, a topic map, cadence and honest targets
When budget and hours are tight, to compare a small start with a fuller one, with dates

tasks.task: Structure playlists and the channel page

items.when: When you need every video in the current playlists listed before you regroup them
When playlists should follow the plan's series, so each has one viewer and one promise
When a playlist needs its best few videos chosen and put in an order that holds attention

tasks.task: Plan the edit, B-roll and on-screen text

items.when: When you have a raw recording and need clean speech, a timed cut list and chapters
When you have clips and the idea, and need a timed cut list, captions and export checks
When captions must be timed in the brand font, with a subtitle file and a fault list
When a cut exists, to get caption and sound checks and fixes ranked by impact
When the owner edits a talking video and would rather cut the transcript than a timeline

tasks.task: Reply to comments and mine them for ideas

items.when: When comments pile up, to sort them, draft short replies in the host's voice and pick one to pin
When you want the repeat questions and complaints counted as ideas for the next videos

tasks.task: Turn a video into posts, emails and an article

items.when: When one strong video should become an article, emails, posts and clips, each in its own form
When the transcript should become an X or LinkedIn post that works without a click
When the set is drafted, to have a fresh reviewer read it as the client and list fixes

tasks.task: Script a product review or a sponsored segment

items.when: When the video reviews products, to build it on real evidence with no made-up hands-on claims
When the segment needs several ways in, to get ten openings and the two to film first
When the sponsor supplies claims, to give each a dated source, a rewrite or a cut

always.when: Before any work that must look or sound like the client's own site and channel
Before any title, description or script is handed over, to catch typos and names spelt two ways
When a script or title states a number, a record or a result you cannot trace to the client

helpers.when: When the job includes cutting the footage, sound and captions, not only planning the edit
When the chosen thumbnail concept must be built as final artwork or a template set
When the video needs a shoot plan, crew, locations or a studio set-up
When video topics must tie to the site's search plan and pages that embed the videos
When Shorts and clips must be posted and scheduled across other platforms
When the channel wants sponsors and needs a rate card, a pitch and deal terms

gaps: No library item plans playlists, the channel home layout, the About text or a channel trailer
No library item plans a presenter's face shots for thumbnails: expressions, light, lens and backdrop
No library item covers creator-side sponsorship: rate card, media kit, sponsor read script and disclosure rules
No library item covers YouTube monetisation: Partner Programme checks, memberships, and advertiser-friendly content rules
No library item checks a video for YouTube's altered or AI-made content label and paid promotion disclosure
No library item plans end screens, cards and pinned comments to send viewers to the next video
No library item makes three different series plans for a video channel to compare; the series arc item is for email
No library item reads a YouTube Studio export by traffic source and audience; only the kit skill does
No library item plans a live stream or premiere on YouTube
No library item writes YouTube Community posts
